name: Call of Duty / Warzone
antiCheat: RICOCHET (kernel driver). Recent titles may require TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot: never propose turning them off. Never modify game files or inject into the process.

configFiles.notes: Per-title options files (for example options.4.cod23.cst) in a custom format: propose changes as manualGuidance through the in-game menu.

competitiveSettings: On-demand texture streaming off on fast connections only if VRAM allows
Frame cap below the VRR limit
Render resolution 100%, upscaler by GPU headroom
cloudSync: Some settings sync to the Activision account.
benchmark: Built-in benchmark where the title has one, otherwise the same private match route before and after.
typicalBound: Usually GPU-bound with high settings; CPU and memory matter at very high refresh rates.
caveats: Starting knowledge, not verified on this PC; executable names change per title. Read the files with powershell-read before proposing changes.
